definitions: To harm oneself out of anger or spite towards another, often resulting in a worse situation for oneself.
To engage in an act of self-sabotage motivated by a desire for revenge or to cause trouble for someone else.
examples: He refused to sell his shares at a profit, cutting off his nose to spite his face, just because he disliked the buyer.
Don't cut off your nose to spite your face by quitting your job over a minor disagreement with your boss.
Their decision to close the successful branch was a classic case of cutting off their nose to spite their face, as it hurt their own profits more than anyone else's.
lemma: cut off nose to spite face
synonyms: bite off more than one can chew
spoil the ship for a ha'porth of tar
